question.question: How is the Conflict deck built, and what happens to unused Conflict cards?

key.expected_answer: Shuffle all four III cards at the bottom, five randomly dealt of nine II cards above, one randomly dealt of three I cards on top: ten total. Return unused cards to the box without looking.

response.answer: Build the 10-card deck with all 4 Conflict III cards on the bottom, 5 of 9 Conflict II cards above them, and 1 of 3 Conflict I cards on top; return all unused Conflict cards to the box without looking.
response.evidence: Setup, step 2: “1 Conflict I on top, 5 Conflict II below it, 4 Conflict III on the bottom”; unused cards return “without looking.”
